simple.meaning: to duplicate or repeat ; by implication, to protest , testify (as by reiteration); intensively, to encompass , restore (as a sort of reduplication)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to עוּד (H5749) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.

definitions.full: H5749. uwd [ עוּד ] verb probably return, go about, repeat, do again (Arabic , return, do again IV. restore , also say again, iterate , habit ; Ethiopic turn about, surround , circuit, circle ; Syriac Pa`el accustom , Ethpe`el, Aph`el be accustomed , usage, ceremong , festival (Brock), whence Arabic id. , as loan-word, Frä 276 ; Palmyrene עידא usage Lzb 337 Cook 90 ; Late Hebrew עֵד , and especially עֵדוּת = Biblical Hebrew, also עִיד festival , עִידָא ᵑ7 ; compare probably Assyrian Shaph`el uš-id , he he solemnly affirmed Dl HWB 32 ); — only intensive : Pi`el surround (compare Ethiopic), Perfect 3masculine singular suffix עִוְּדֻנִי Psa 119:61 (compare סְבָבוּנִי 18:6 ). Pol`el , restore, relieve (compare Arabic IV.), Imperfect 3masculine singular יְעוֺדֵד , with accusative of person Psa 146:9 (|| שָׁמַר , opposed to עִוֵּת ), 147:6 (opposed to הִשְׁמִּיל ). Hithpolel be restored, Imperfect 1plural וַנִּתְעוֺדָּ֑ד Psa 20:9 ( + קוּם , opposed to נָפַל ; ᵐ5 ἀνωρθώθημεν . [ עוּד ] verb denominative (Gerber 42f. ) bear witness ; — Qal Imperfect 1singular suffix אֲעוּדֵךְ Lam 2:13 Kt; < Hiph`il Qr Bu. Hiph`il Perfect 3masculine singular הֵעִיד 2Kin 17:15 ; Mal 2:14 ; הֵעִד Gen 43:3 ; 2 masculine singular ַהעִי֫דֹתָ Neh 9:34 ; ַהעֵדֹ֫תָה Exod 19:23 ; 1 singular ַהעִידֹ֫תִי Deut 4:26 ; Jer 42:19 ; 3 masculine plural הֵעִ֫ידוּ Neh 9:26 , etc.; Imperfect וַיָּ֫עַד 2Kin 17:13 ; Zech 3:6 ; 3 feminine singular suffix וַתְּעִידֵ֫נִי Job 29:11 15 t. Imperfect; Infinitive absolute הָעֵד Gen 43:3-4 t.; Imperative הָעֵד Exod 19:21 2 t. Imperative Participle מֵעִיד Deut 32:46 . — 1 testify, bear witness , with suffix against one 1Kin 21:10 , 13 ; in favour of Job 29:11 ; Lam 2:13 (Qr); with בֵּין Mal 2:14 . 2 cause to testify, take as witness , with accusative of person Isa 8:2 ; Jer 32:10 , 25 , 44 ; call as witness, invoke , with accusative הארץ ואת השׁמים את + בְּ against Deut 4:26 ; 30:19 ; 31:28 . 3 protest, affirm solemnly, warn: subject men, absolute Jer 6:10 ; Neh 13:15 ; with בְּ person Gen 43:3 (twice in verse) (J) Exod 19:21 (E) 1Sam 8:9 (twice in verse); 1Kin 2:42 ; 2Chr 24:19 ; Neh 9:26 ; 13:21 ; Jer 42:19 ; Amos 3:13 ; exhort solemnly, admonish, charge , ׳י subject, with בְּ person, Exod 19:23 (J) Deut 8:19 ; 2Kin 17:13 ; Neh 9:29-30 , Jer 11:7 (3 t. in verse); Zech 3:6 ; Psa 50:7 ; 81:9 ; enjoin solemnly , with בְּ person + accusative of thing עֵדְוֺת 2Kin 17:15 ; Neh 9:34 , דברים Deut 32:46 . Hoph`al Perfect 3masculine singular וְהוּעַד consecutive Exod 21:29 (E) impersonal and protest be entered , with בְּ person
